requirements.title: find_references tool registration and input validation
requirements.rationale: A model or agent needs a discovery tool to find callers and reference sites across the workspace while rejecting invalid inputs early.

criteria.action: register in tools.All() immediately following find_symbol and preceding shell tools, register in tools.FileNavigationTools() expanding the list to six tool names, configure with Builtin true, ExecutionMode Parallel, non-shell status outside guard.ShellToolNames, and prompt guideline 'Use find_symbol for where a name is declared, find_references for who uses it, and search_files for text.'
criteria.contract: tools.All() contains find_references immediately following find_symbol and preceding shell tools; tools.FileNavigationTools() contains exactly six tools including find_references; find_references has Builtin set to true and ExecutionMode set to core.Parallel; find_references is not present in guard.ShellToolNames; find_references prompt guidelines contain 'Use find_symbol for where a name is declared, find_references for who uses it, and search_files for text.'

setup: a tool set created with default options and workspace
check.pseudocode: all, err := tools.All(opts); idxFS := indexOf(all, "find_symbol"); idxFR := indexOf(all, "find_references"); assert idxFR == idxFS + 1; nav := tools.FileNavigationTools(); assert len(nav) == 6 && contains(nav, "find_references"); fr := all[idxFR]; assert fr.Builtin && fr.ExecutionMode == core.Parallel && !guard.ShellToolNames[fr.Name]; assert contains(fr.PromptGuidelines, "Use find_symbol for where a name is declared, find_references for who uses it, and search_files for text.")

criteria.action: declare an input schema specifying required string parameter name (maximum 256 bytes), optional string parameter path, optional string parameter kind, optional boolean parameter include_tests (defaulting to true), and optional integer parameter max_results (default 30, cap 100)
criteria.contract: InputSchema is an Object schema; property 'name' is required and of type string; properties 'path', 'kind', 'include_tests', and 'max_results' are optional; property 'include_tests' is of type boolean; property 'max_results' is of type integer

setup: the find_references tool definition from tools.All()
check.pseudocode: fr := getTool("find_references"); schema := fr.InputSchema; assert schema.IsRequired("name"); assert schema.PropertyList()["name"].Type == schema.TypeString; assert schema.PropertyList()["include_tests"].Type == schema.TypeBoolean; assert schema.PropertyList()["max_results"].Type == schema.TypeInteger

criteria.condition: the tool input cannot be unmarshaled as valid JSON, or name is missing, consists solely of whitespace, or exceeds 256 bytes
criteria.action: reject the call without reading the workspace filesystem
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code invalid_arguments, and non-empty error message

setup: a workspace and initialized fileTools
check.pseudocode: for in := range []string{"{bad-json", "{}", "{\"name\":\"\"}", "{\"name\":\"   \"}", "{\"name\":\"" + strings.Repeat("a", 257) + "\"}"} { res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(in)); assert !res.OK && res.Error == "invalid_arguments" && res.Text != "" }

criteria.condition: the kind parameter is provided and does not match func, method, type, class, interface, enum, trait, const, var, module, or macro
criteria.action: reject the call without searching the workspace
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code invalid_arguments, and message listing valid kinds

setup: a workspace and initialized fileTools
check.pseudocode: res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo","kind":"struct"}`)); assert !res.OK && res.Error == "invalid_arguments"; for _, k := range validKinds { assert strings.Contains(res.Text, k) }

criteria.condition: the path parameter resolves outside the workspace root per Workspace.Resolve
criteria.action: refuse the call without inspecting filesystem entries
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code path_not_allowed

setup: a workspace with a temporary directory root
check.pseudocode: res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo","path":"../outside"}`)); assert !res.OK && res.Error == "path_not_allowed"

criteria.condition: the path parameter resolves inside the workspace root but does not exist on disk or does not refer to a directory
criteria.action: reject the call
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code invalid_arguments, and message stating the directory was not found

setup: a workspace containing a regular file 'main.go' and no directory named 'missing_dir'
check.pseudocode: res1 := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo","path":"missing_dir"}`)); assert !res1.OK && res1.Error == "invalid_arguments" && strings.Contains(res1.Text, "directory"); res2 := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo","path":"main.go"}`)); assert !res2.OK && res2.Error == "invalid_arguments"

criteria.condition: the execution context is cancelled before or during reference search execution
criteria.action: terminate execution immediately and return an error result
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code aborted, and message 'Operation aborted'

setup: a workspace with source files and an already cancelled context
check.pseudocode: ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background()); cancel(); res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo"}`)); assert !res.OK && res.Error == "aborted" && res.Text == "Operation aborted"

requirements.title: Declaration resolution and disambiguation from symbol table
requirements.rationale: Resolving queried names against the in-memory symbol table provides semantic declaration targets while preserving fallback behavior for undeclared identifiers.

criteria.condition: find_references receives a declaration name
criteria.action: query the shared in-memory symbol table to locate matching declarations by unqualified name or container-qualified name
criteria.contract: Candidate declaration list returned or empty set if no matching symbol exists

setup: a workspace containing type Runner with method Run, and a standalone function Run
check.pseudocode: matches := resolveSymbolCandidates(st, "Run", "", ""); assert len(matches) == 2; m2 := resolveSymbolCandidates(st, "Runner.Run", "", ""); assert len(m2) == 1 && m2[0].Container == "Runner" && m2[0].Name == "Run"

criteria.condition: candidate declarations are located in the symbol table and a path or kind parameter is specified in the tool call
criteria.action: filter candidate declarations to entries matching the specified declaration kind and residing within the specified directory scope
criteria.contract: Candidate set retains only declarations matching all active filter constraints

setup: a workspace containing a type Config in 'pkg/config.go' and a function Config in 'pkg/setup.go' and a type Config in 'cmd/main.go'
check.pseudocode: matches := resolveSymbolCandidates(st, "Config", "type", "pkg"); assert len(matches) == 1 && matches[0].Path == "pkg/config.go" && matches[0].Kind == "type"

criteria.condition: multiple candidate declarations match the queried name and active filters and a target declaration must be selected
criteria.action: select the highest-ranked declaration applying find_symbol ranking precedence: exact name match over prefix match, exported over unexported, non-test file over test file per isTestFile, shorter workspace-relative path length, then ascending 1-based start line
criteria.contract: Exactly one top-ranked candidate selected as the target declaration

setup: a symbol table containing multiple candidates matching 'Handle': unexported 'handle' in test file, unexported 'handle' in 'a.go', exported 'Handle' in 'test/handle_test.go', and exported 'Handle' in 'pkg/handle.go'
check.pseudocode: target := disambiguateSymbol(candidates); assert target.Path == "pkg/handle.go" && target.Name == "Handle"

criteria.condition: no declaration in the symbol table matches the queried name and no active filters or active filters eliminated all candidates
criteria.action: proceed with a workspace-wide text search without returning an error, setting the result target to a zero outline.Decl, backend to 'text', and recording zero declaration matches in the text header
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK true, target set to zero outline.Decl, backend 'text', and text header noting zero matched declarations

setup: a workspace containing files mentioning string 'GOPHER_KEY' but no declaration in symbol table
check.pseudocode: res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"GOPHER_KEY"}`)); assert res.OK; data := res.Data.(ReferenceResult); assert data.Target == outline.Decl{} && data.Backend == "text"; assert strings.Contains(res.Text, "0 references") || strings.Contains(res.Text, "text matches")

criteria.action: for any qualified declaration name formatted as Container.Member, split the identifier at the last dot and match member declarations whose container matches the container prefix in the symbol table
criteria.contract: the container prefix equals all characters before the last dot; the member name equals all characters after the last dot; matched symbol declarations have Container matching container prefix and Name matching member name

setup: an in-memory symbol table populated with nested types and containers
check.pseudocode: for name in genQualifiedNames() { container, member := splitContainerMember(name); match := matchContainerSymbol(st, container, member); if match != nil { assert match.Container == container && match.Name == member } }

requirements.title: Go type resolution engine and resolved confidence
requirements.rationale: In-process Go type analysis provides exact caller resolution across packages without external tooling or language servers.

criteria.condition: Go source packages in the workspace are type-checked
criteria.action: parse Go source files using go/parser and type-check packages using go/types with a workspace-local importer mapping module import paths to local directories
criteria.contract: Workspace Go packages are checked in memory without external processes or network access

setup: a Go workspace with root go.mod defining module 'example.com/mod' and subpackages 'pkg/a' and 'pkg/b' importing 'pkg/a'
check.pseudocode: imp := newWorkspaceImporter(ws, "example.com/mod"); pkg, err := checkPackage(imp, "pkg/b"); assert err == nil && pkg != nil; assert pkg.Imports()[0].Path() == "example.com/mod/pkg/a"

criteria.condition: an import path refers to standard library or third-party packages outside the workspace
criteria.action: answer the import with an empty synthetic types.Package defining zero symbols, configure types.Config with FakeImportC true, and collect type errors without aborting or panicking
criteria.contract: Incomplete external packages complete type checking without fatal error or process termination

setup: a Go source file importing standard library 'fmt', 'os' and external 'github.com/stretchr/testify/assert' and 'C'
check.pseudocode: cfg := makeTypesConfig(importer); pkg, errs := typeCheck(cfg, parsedFiles); assert pkg != nil; assert importer.imported["fmt"].Scope().Len() == 0; assert len(errs) > 0

criteria.condition: an identifier occurrence in Go source matches the target declaration name and types.Info.Uses or types.Info.Defs associates the identifier with the target declaration's types.Object
criteria.action: classify the reference site with resolved confidence, resolving receiver method calls, interface method invocations, renamed imports, and promoted embedded fields to the target declaration
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite created with Confidence set to 'resolved'

setup: a Go workspace with interface Reader, struct Buffer implementing Reader, renamed package import 'alias', and embedded struct Base with method Ping
check.pseudocode: sites := resolveGoReferences(targetPing); assert len(sites) > 0; for _, s := range sites { assert s.Confidence == "resolved" }

criteria.condition: an identifier occurrence in Go source matches the target declaration name and its resolved types.Object belongs to an unrelated type or a distinct package
criteria.action: exclude the identifier occurrence from reference matches
criteria.contract: Zero reference sites generated for unrelated same-named symbols

setup: a Go workspace with type Alpha defining method Close() and type Beta defining method Close() in another package
check.pseudocode: sites := resolveGoReferences(alphaClose); for _, s := range sites { assert s.Path == "alpha_caller.go" && !strings.Contains(s.Source, "beta.Close") }

criteria.condition: an identifier occurrence in Go source matches the target declaration name and its type cannot be resolved because its receiver or parameter originates from a stubbed external import
criteria.action: classify the reference site with lexical confidence rather than dropping the match
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite created with Confidence set to 'lexical'

setup: a Go function receiving an interface from stubbed external package 'external.Client' calling 'client.Do()' where 'Do' matches target declaration
check.pseudocode: sites := resolveGoReferences(targetDo); hit := findSite(sites, "client.Do()"); assert hit != nil && hit.Confidence == "lexical"

criteria.action: for any Go package in the workspace, parse source files with comments preserved and record 1-based line and 1-based column offsets using token.FileSet
criteria.contract: the parsed ast.File includes all comment groups; every identifier node maps to a 1-based line and 1-based column position via the token.FileSet; position line and column are strictly greater than zero

setup: a workspace containing arbitrary valid Go source files
check.pseudocode: for pkg := range genGoPackages() { fset, files, err := parseGoPackageWithComments(pkg); assert err == nil; for _, f := range files { assert len(f.Comments) >= 0; ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool { if id, ok := n.(*ast.Ident); ok { p := fset.Position(id.Pos()); assert p.Line >= 1 && p.Column >= 1 }; return true }) } }

requirements.title: Lexical and text reference scanning across workspace files
requirements.rationale: Scanning non-Go files and fallback occurrences with word boundaries enables broad multi-language reference discovery.

criteria.condition: candidate files are traversed for reference scanning
criteria.action: traverse workspace files using tools.Walk respecting .gitignore rules, hidden entry exclusion, and optional tools.Index candidate acceleration if configured
criteria.contract: Candidate files exclude ignored or hidden paths

setup: a workspace with .gitignore ignoring 'build/', a hidden directory '.git/', and active files in 'src/'
check.pseudocode: candidates := findCandidateFiles(ws, "Run", mockIndex); for _, c := range candidates { assert !strings.HasPrefix(c, ".git/") && !strings.HasPrefix(c, "build/") }

criteria.condition: a candidate file is covered by outline extractors for Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, C, C++, C#, Java, Kotlin, or Ruby and the target declaration was identified in the symbol table
criteria.action: scan the file content for whole-identifier word-boundary matches matching the target name
criteria.contract: Matches isolated to identifier boundaries

setup: a Python file containing 'def run_all():', 'runner.run()', and 'runaway = 1'
check.pseudocode: matches := scanFileForName("test.py", "run"); assert len(matches) == 1 && matches[0].LineText == "runner.run()"

criteria.condition: an identifier-boundary match occurs in an outline-supported file and the match line falls outside comment blocks and string literals and the target declaration exists in the symbol table
criteria.action: classify the reference site with lexical confidence
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite created with Confidence set to 'lexical'

setup: a TypeScript file declaring a caller 'service.execute()' with a known symbol table target 'execute'
check.pseudocode: site := scanNonGoSite("app.ts", "service.execute()", targetDecl); assert site.Confidence == "lexical"

criteria.condition: an identifier match occurs inside a comment or string literal, or within a file unsupported by outline extractors and the target declaration exists in the symbol table
criteria.action: classify the reference site with text confidence
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite created with Confidence set to 'text'

setup: a Python file containing comment '# call execute here' and string '\"call execute\"' and an unsupported Markdown file with 'execute'
check.pseudocode: sites := scanAllSites("execute", targetDecl); for _, s := range sites { if isCommentOrString(s) || isMarkdown(s) { assert s.Confidence == "text" } }

criteria.condition: a reference search executes and the target declaration was not located in the symbol table
criteria.action: classify all reference matches across all scanned files with text confidence
criteria.contract: Every reported ReferenceSite carries Confidence 'text'

setup: a workspace with Python, Go, and TypeScript files containing 'MY_GLOBAL_VAR' which is not in symbol table
check.pseudocode: sites := scanAllSites("MY_GLOBAL_VAR", outline.Decl{}); for _, s := range sites { assert s.Confidence == "text" }

criteria.action: for any reference match line, determine the 1-based line number and 1-based byte column offset of the match start
criteria.contract: the line number is 1-based (line >= 1); the column offset is 1-based byte index of the identifier start (col >= 1); the byte slice at line[col-1 : col-1+len(name)] equals the target name

setup: arbitrary text file lines with indentation and UTF-8 characters
check.pseudocode: for match := range genMatchSites() { assert match.Line >= 1 && match.Column >= 1; line := getRawLine(match.Path, match.Line); assert line[match.Column-1:match.Column-1+len(targetName)] == targetName }

requirements.title: Enclosing declaration attribution and line formatting
requirements.rationale: Attributing each reference site to its surrounding function or class gives agents immediate structural context without extra outline calls.

criteria.condition: a reference site is identified at a 1-based line number within a file
criteria.action: inspect the file's declaration outline from outline.File.Decls to identify all declarations whose StartLine is less than or equal to the site line and EndLine is greater than or equal to the site line
criteria.contract: Enclosing candidate declaration list identified

setup: a file outline containing functions at lines 10-20, 25-35, and 40-50
check.pseudocode: decls := []outline.Decl{{StartLine: 10, EndLine: 20}, {StartLine: 25, EndLine: 35}, {StartLine: 40, EndLine: 50}}; enc := findEnclosing(decls, 30); assert enc.StartLine == 25 && enc.EndLine == 35

criteria.condition: multiple nested declarations span the reference site line and at least one declaration encompasses another
criteria.action: assign the innermost declaration with the smallest line span to ReferenceSite.Enclosing
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite.Enclosing set to the innermost outline.Decl

setup: a file outline with outer class 'Engine' at lines 10-60 and inner method 'Start' at lines 20-30
check.pseudocode: decls := []outline.Decl{{Name: "Engine", StartLine: 10, EndLine: 60}, {Name: "Start", StartLine: 20, EndLine: 30}}; enc := findEnclosing(decls, 25); assert enc.Name == "Start"

criteria.condition: a reference site line falls outside all declarations in outline.File.Decls and the site is located at file top level
criteria.action: set ReferenceSite.Enclosing to a zero outline.Decl with Kind set to 'file'
criteria.contract: ReferenceSite.Enclosing.Kind equals 'file'

setup: a file outline with a declaration starting at line 15, and a reference site at line 5 (top-level import or var)
check.pseudocode: decls := []outline.Decl{{Name: "Foo", StartLine: 15, EndLine: 25}}; enc := findEnclosing(decls, 5); assert enc.Kind == "file" && enc.Name == ""

criteria.action: render the enclosing declaration label as its signature or '<Kind> <Name>' when Enclosing.Kind is not 'file', and render '<file>' when Enclosing.Kind equals 'file'
criteria.contract: the first renders as 'func (r *Runner) Run() error'; the second renders as 'class Controller'; the top-level declaration renders as '<file>'

setup: a declaration with signature 'func (r *Runner) Run() error', a declaration without signature 'class Controller', and a top-level file declaration
check.pseudocode: assert renderEnclosingLabel(declWithSig) == "func (r *Runner) Run() error"; assert renderEnclosingLabel(declWithoutSig) == "class Controller"; assert renderEnclosingLabel(fileDecl) == "<file>"

criteria.action: for any reference site, extract the source line containing the match, trim leading and trailing whitespace, cap the string length at 200 bytes, and replace ASCII control characters with spaces
criteria.contract: leading and trailing whitespace is stripped; byte length of the resulting snippet does not exceed 200 bytes; no ASCII control characters (byte < 0x20, except space) exist in the output snippet

setup: arbitrary raw source lines containing whitespace, tabs, control characters (\x00-\x1F), and varying byte lengths
check.pseudocode: for raw := range genRawLines() { snip := sanitizeSnippet(raw); assert !strings.HasPrefix(snip, " ") && !strings.HasSuffix(snip, " "); assert len([]byte(snip)) <= 200; for _, b := range []byte(snip) { assert b >= 0x20 || b >= 0x7F } }

requirements.title: Result ranking, bounds, and truncation
requirements.rationale: Strict sorting and safety bounds ensure prompt responses on large workspaces and deterministic output for agent reproducibility.

criteria.action: sort all reference sites deterministically using four-tier order: confidence tier (resolved before lexical before text), non-test files before test files per isTestFile, alphabetical workspace-relative path, then ascending 1-based line number and ascending 1-based column
criteria.contract: all 'resolved' sites precede 'lexical' sites, which precede 'text' sites; within confidence tier, non-test files precede test files; within test status, files are sorted alphabetically by slash-separated path; within a file, sites are sorted by ascending line number, then ascending column

setup: a list of unsorted ReferenceSite entries spanning resolved, lexical, and text confidences across test and non-test files
check.pseudocode: sortReferenceSites(sites); for i := 0; i < len(sites)-1; i++ { assert siteOrderLess(sites[i], sites[i+1]) }

criteria.condition: include_tests is specified as false and reference sites are collected
criteria.action: filter out and omit all reference sites located in test files or test directories identified by isTestFile
criteria.contract: Result contains zero reference sites from test files

setup: collected reference sites located in 'pkg/client.go', 'pkg/client_test.go', and 'test/helper.go'
check.pseudocode: filtered := filterTestSites(sites, false); for _, s := range filtered { assert !isTestFile(s.Path) }

criteria.condition: the number of matching reference sites exceeds max_results and max_results is clamped between 1 and 100
criteria.action: truncate the sites slice to max_results entries, set Truncated to true, and append an advisory marker generated by CapMarker('references', 'max_results', limit, 100, 'narrow with path or kind')
criteria.contract: Sites slice length equals clamped max_results and Truncated equals true

setup: a result with 50 matching reference sites and max_results set to 20
check.pseudocode: res := applyResultLimits(sites, 20); assert len(res.Sites) == 20 && res.Truncated; wantMarker := CapMarker("references", "max_results", 20, 100, "narrow with path or kind"); assert strings.Contains(res.MarkerText, wantMarker)

criteria.condition: file traversal reaches SymbolOptions.MaxFiles (50 000) or execution duration reaches SymbolOptions.MaxDuration (2 s) and the reference pass has not finished inspecting all candidate files
criteria.action: halt traversal without error, return reference sites collected prior to limit expiration, set Partial to true, and append SymbolPartialMarker to the text output
criteria.contract: ToolResult returned with OK true, Partial true, and SymbolPartialMarker appended

setup: a reference query configured with an expiring deadline or MaxFiles limit reached during traversal
check.pseudocode: res := executeWithShortTimeout(ctx, fr, "Run"); assert res.OK && res.Data.(ReferenceResult).Partial; assert strings.Contains(res.Text, SymbolPartialMarker())

criteria.action: for any call with max_results unsupplied or less than or equal to 0, default max_results to 30, and for any max_results exceeding 100, clamp max_results to 100
criteria.contract: max_results <= 0 defaults to 30; max_results > 100 clamps to 100; max_results in 1..100 remains unchanged

setup: arbitrary integer input for max_results
check.pseudocode: for val in genInts() { clamped := clampMaxResults(val); if val <= 0 { assert clamped == 30 } else if val > 100 { assert clamped == 100 } else { assert clamped == val } }

requirements.title: Result rendering and structured data output
requirements.rationale: Compact hierarchical text minimizes model token consumption while structured data empowers programmatic analysis.

criteria.action: render ToolResult.Text with an initial header line formatted as 'find_references <name>  (<backend>, <N> references in <M> files; <K> text matches)' where backend is 'go/types', 'lexical', or 'text', appending a partial note when Partial is true
criteria.contract: first line format matches 'find_references <name>  (go/types, 5 references in 2 files; 1 text matches) [partial]'; name and backend are accurately reflected in header

setup: reference query results with backend 'go/types', 5 references across 2 files, 1 text match, and Partial true
check.pseudocode: txt := renderResultText(res); firstLine := strings.Split(txt, "\n")[0]; assert strings.HasPrefix(firstLine, "find_references Run  (go/types, 5 references in 2 files; 1 text matches)") && strings.Contains(firstLine, "partial")

criteria.action: render reference sites grouped by file with slash-separated relative path headers followed by indented site lines formatted as '  L<line>  <confidence>  <enclosing>  <source_line>' with padded enclosing declaration alignment
criteria.contract: file path 'pkg/runner.go' appears as a header line; sites appear indented with format '  L<line>  <confidence>  <enclosing>  <source_line>'; enclosing declaration column is padded for alignment across lines in the group

setup: two reference sites in 'pkg/runner.go' at lines 12 and 45
check.pseudocode: txt := renderResultText(res); assert strings.Contains(txt, "pkg/runner.go\n  L12  resolved  func Start() error      runner.Run()"); assert strings.Contains(txt, "  L45  resolved  func Stop()              runner.Run()")

criteria.condition: a reference query result is truncated or partial and truncation or partial limits were triggered during execution
criteria.action: append the truncation marker or partial marker text at the end of ToolResult.Text
criteria.contract: Markers appear on distinct lines at the conclusion of Text

setup: a result with Truncated true and Partial true
check.pseudocode: txt := renderResultText(truncatedPartialRes); lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(txt), "\n"); assert strings.Contains(lines[len(lines)-2], "cap=") || strings.Contains(lines[len(lines)-1], "cap="); assert strings.Contains(txt, SymbolPartialMarker())

criteria.action: populate ToolResult.Data with a ReferenceResult struct containing Target (outline.Decl), Sites ([]ReferenceSite), Backend (string), Partial (bool), Truncated (bool), PackagesChecked (int), and Errors (int)
criteria.contract: Data can be asserted as ReferenceResult; Target, Sites, Backend, Partial, Truncated, PackagesChecked, and Errors are populated with appropriate values

setup: a completed reference resolution run
check.pseudocode: data, ok := res.Data.(ReferenceResult); assert ok; assert data.Backend != ""; assert data.PackagesChecked >= 0 && data.Errors >= 0

criteria.condition: a reference search yields zero matching sites across all candidate files
criteria.action: return a successful ToolResult whose Text indicates zero references found and whose Sites slice is empty
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK true and empty Sites slice

setup: a workspace where no file contains the queried identifier
check.pseudocode: res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"NeverUsed"}`)); assert res.OK; data := res.Data.(ReferenceResult); assert len(data.Sites) == 0; assert strings.Contains(res.Text, "0 references")

requirements.title: Reference cache lifecycle, freshness, and invalidation
requirements.rationale: Caching package type checks and outlines provides low latency while invalidation hooks prevent stale results after tool mutations.

criteria.condition: the first reference query is executed on a fileTools instance
criteria.action: initialize the in-memory reference cache lazily and maintain cached packages and outlines across subsequent queries for the lifetime of fileTools
criteria.contract: Cache is retained in memory without persisting to disk

setup: a newly created fileTools instance with no prior reference queries
check.pseudocode: assert ft.refCache == nil; ft.getRefCache(); c1 := ft.refCache; assert c1 != nil; ft.getRefCache(); c2 := ft.refCache; assert c1 == c2

criteria.condition: write_file or edit_file releases its per-path lock after completing a file modification
criteria.action: mark the modified workspace-relative path dirty in the reference cache
criteria.contract: Path flagged as dirty for subsequent queries

setup: an initialized reference cache containing cached file entries
check.pseudocode: writeFileTool.Execute(ctx, writeArgs); assert refCache.isPathDirty("pkg/service.go"); editFileTool.Execute(ctx, editArgs); assert refCache.isPathDirty("pkg/service.go")

criteria.condition: a shell tool (execute, run_command, or powershell) finishes execution
criteria.action: mark all cached packages and files for revalidation
criteria.contract: Whole-table revalidation flag set

setup: an initialized reference cache with multiple cached packages
check.pseudocode: execTool.Execute(ctx, execArgs); assert refCache.needsRevalidateAll()

criteria.condition: a reference query is initiated while dirty paths or whole-table revalidation flags are pending
criteria.action: re-parse dirty Go packages, re-outline dirty non-Go files, and remove entries for files deleted from disk before resolving references
criteria.contract: Query executes against updated filesystem state

setup: a cached Go package and Python file, where Go file was modified, Python file was re-saved, and an extra file was deleted
check.pseudocode: refCache.markDirty("pkg/a.go"); refCache.refresh(ctx); assert !refCache.isPathDirty("pkg/a.go"); assert !refCache.hasFile("deleted.go")

criteria.condition: a .gitignore or nested ignore file is modified
criteria.action: revalidate the candidate file set on the subsequent reference search pass
criteria.contract: Candidate traversal reflects updated ignore rules

setup: a workspace where 'ignored_dir/' is unignored, then .gitignore is updated to ignore 'ignored_dir/'
check.pseudocode: os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(ws.Root, ".gitignore"), []byte("ignored_dir/\n"), 0644); refCache.markDirty(".gitignore"); res := fr.Execute(ctx, []byte(`{"name":"Foo"}`)); for _, s := range res.Data.(ReferenceResult).Sites { assert !strings.HasPrefix(s.Path, "ignored_dir/") }

requirements.title: Exported embedder seam on Workspace
requirements.rationale: Direct programmatic access to reference analysis enables static analysis and code intelligence without model prompt execution.

criteria.action: export ReferenceOptions, ReferenceSite, ReferenceResult types and export method (*Workspace).References(ctx context.Context, target outline.Decl, opts ReferenceOptions) (ReferenceResult, error) on *Workspace
criteria.contract: ReferenceOptions struct has Path, IncludeTests, MaxResults fields; ReferenceSite struct has Path, Line, Column, Confidence, Enclosing, Source fields; ReferenceResult struct has Target, Sites, Backend, Partial, PackagesChecked, Errors, Truncated fields; (*Workspace).References method accepts context.Context, outline.Decl, ReferenceOptions and returns (ReferenceResult, error)

setup: the tools package
check.pseudocode: var _ func(context.Context, outline.Decl, tools.ReferenceOptions) (tools.ReferenceResult, error) = (*tools.Workspace).References

criteria.condition: (*Workspace).References is invoked with a target declaration and options

criteria.contract: Returns ErrPathNotAllowed and empty ReferenceResult

criteria.contract: Returns ctx.Err() and empty ReferenceResult

criteria.action: for any call with opts.MaxResults less than or equal to 0, default maximum results to 30, and for any opts.MaxResults exceeding 100, clamp maximum results to 100

check.pseudocode: for val in genInts() { norm := normalizeWorkspaceMaxResults(val); if val <= 0 { assert norm == 30 } else if val > 100 { assert norm == 100 } else { assert norm == val } }

execution_paths.title: Finding Go method callers across packages with exact type resolution

steps.action: invokes find_references with name 'Runner.Run' in a Go workspace
queries the symbol table and selects the highest-ranked declaration for 'Runner.Run'
parses workspace Go packages and resolves identifier references using go/types with synthetic stub imports
attributes each reference site to its enclosing function declaration from the outline
ranks resolved sites ahead of lexical hits and returns a structured ToolResult with confidence 'resolved'

maps each match line to the enclosing Python function or class declaration
formats and returns a ToolResult with backend 'lexical' and enclosing signatures

execution_paths.title: Cache invalidation and revalidation following file modification

steps.action: invokes write_file to update a Go file introducing a new caller of an existing function
writes content to disk and marks the file path dirty in the reference cache
invokes find_references for the target function
re-parses and re-checks the modified Go package before computing references
returns updated references reflecting the newly introduced caller site

setup: a tool set initialized on a workspace with Go packages and an initial find_references query
end_state: write_file marks the package dirty in the reference cache
subsequent find_references re-checks the package and discovers the newly added caller site
the new site is attributed to the new caller function with confidence 'resolved'
